### Reference: resources, embedders and sectioners

#### `ResourceProvider`

interface · `import { ResourceProvider } from '@harness/sdk'`

A system's resource service: its roots, and listing, stat, reading and watching under them.

```ts
interface ResourceProvider {
  roots(): Promise<ResourceRoot[]>;
  list(uri: ResourceUri, cursor?: string): Promise<Page<ResourceStat>>;
  stat(uri: ResourceUri): Promise<ResourceStat | undefined>;
  /**
   * A read. It may include more than was asked for if it had it anyway. Content that isn't text (a picture, a pdf, a
   * recording) goes as its bytes, so the hub reads it the way its kind needs; text goes as text.
   */
  read(uri: ResourceUri, want: ReadWant[]): Promise<ProvidedRead>;
  /** Report changes until the returned function is called. */
  watch?(uris: ResourceUri[], onChange: (changes: ResourceChange[]) => void): () => void;
}
```

Refers to: [`Page`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-page), [`ReadWant`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-readwant), [`ResourceChange`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-resourcechange), [`ResourceRoot`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-resourceroot), [`ResourceStat`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-resourcestat), [`ResourceUri`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-resourceuri).

#### `ProvidedRead`

type · `import { ProvidedRead } from '@harness/sdk'`

A read as a provider makes it: a `ResourceRead`, except that its bytes may be the bytes themselves (`data` and their
`mime`). The SDK holds those for the hub to fetch and sends their ref, so a provider never handles content refs.

```ts
type ProvidedRead = Omit<ResourceRead, 'bytes'> & { readonly bytes?: ContentRef | ProvidedBytes | undefined };
```

Refers to: [`ContentRef`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-contentref), [`ResourceRead`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-resourceread).

#### `ProvidedBytes`

interface · `import { ProvidedBytes } from '@harness/sdk'`

A file's bytes as a provider hands them over, with their media type.

```ts
interface ProvidedBytes {
  readonly data: Uint8Array;
  readonly mime: string;
}
```

#### `sectioner`

function · `import { sectioner } from '@harness/sdk'`

Declare a sectioner.

```ts
function sectioner(def: { description: string; match: SectionMatch; }): SectionerDef;
```

Refers to: [`SectionMatch`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-sectionmatch).

#### `SectionerDef`

interface · `import { SectionerDef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A way of cutting resources into sections, offered to users as a choice for matching resources.

```ts
interface SectionerDef {
  readonly description: string;
  readonly match: SectionMatch;
}
```

Refers to: [`SectionMatch`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-sectionmatch).

#### `SectionerImpl`

type · `import { SectionerImpl } from '@harness/sdk'`

A sectioner's implementation. Keys must come from structure (`sectionKey(path)`), never from position.

```ts
type SectionerImpl = (text: string, stat: ResourceStat) => Promise<Section[]>;
```

Refers to: [`ResourceStat`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-resourcestat), [`Section`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-section).

#### `SectionerRef`

interface · `import { SectionerRef } from '@harness/sdk'`

A handle to a sectioner.

```ts
interface SectionerRef<N extends QualifiedName> {
  readonly ref: 'sectioner';
  readonly name: N;
}
```

Refers to: [`QualifiedName`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.primitives-ts#core-qualifiedname).

#### `sectionKeys`

function · `import { sectionKeys } from '@harness/sdk'`

Make section keys from outline paths, in document order, by `@aeye/resources`' rules (the same keys its markdown
and code slicers give): each key is the path joined with ` > `, `(root)` for an empty path, and a path seen before
gets ` ~2`, ` ~3` so keys stay unique while still coming from structure.

```ts
function sectionKeys(paths: readonly (readonly string[])[]): SectionKey[];
```

Refers to: [`SectionKey`](context:fs/authoring.core-types.resources-ts#core-sectionkey).
